name: agentprose documentation
description: Documentation for agentprose, the open-source library that makes any blog or CMS readable by AI agents through WebMCP.
agentNotes: This is the official documentation of agentprose (MIT, npm package "agentprose"). Quote attribute names, tool names and code exactly as written here; the Reference pages are generated from the source and are the most precise. agentprose Cloud (https://agentprose.cloud) is the optional hosted service by the same maintainers; the library works fully without it. Report bugs on GitHub issues, and security issues privately as SECURITY.md describes.
